To position or be positioned physically:
To support oneself on the feet in an erect position.

examples.text: Here I stand, wondering what to do next.
I can't reach the celing. Get me a chair to stand on.
Then came a maid with hand-bag and shawls, and after her a tall young lady. She stood for a moment holding her skirt above the grimy steps,[…], and the light of the reflector fell full upon her.

glosses: To position or be positioned physically:
To rise to one’s feet; to stand up.

examples.text: Stand up, walk to the refrigerator, and get your own snack.

glosses: To position or be positioned physically:
To remain motionless.

examples.text: Do not leave your car standing in the road.
